svg.title: Capsule: grouped program execution with constrained runtime actions
svg.desc: A pastel architecture diagram based on a Cube Restack example. Generated code is grouped into five source-local units, summarized in pseudocode. A runtime control LLM selects constrained code-level actions. A persistent executor calls the simulator APIs. Source-bound feedback closes the loop. The simulation illustration is schematic.

g.text: Cube Restack example · source-preserving grouping and closed-loop runtime control
Place the red cube on the green cube,
P → [ G₁, G₂, G₃, G₄, G₅ ]
AST structure · def–use dependencies · API effects
Grouping preserves the original code and its order.
History guard: no rerun / patch after effects
Recovery code must obtain a fresh observation
Robot APIs · observations · reward · task state
Group boundaries support local execution, inspection, repair, and forward recovery.
Five groups follow the supplied Cube Restack source spans. Pseudocode, feedback fields, and simulator view are schematic; group-focused actions are shown.
